# Roots the effect preview sweeps: one path substring per line, `#` comments
# allowed. `PWE_PREVIEW_ROOTS` on the command line or a `workflow_dispatch`
# input overrides this file; nothing here changes how a root is drawn.
#
# One line on purpose: `水族箱` matches the whole Raging Tides aquarium — the
# tank glass, the kelp in three colours, the starfish, the lid and the fish — so
# the plants and the box they sit in are measured by the same run at the same
# camera, which is the only way to tell an oversized plant from a small tank.
#
# A wider sweep costs a shot per root and the run stops at PWE_PREVIEW_MAX, so a
# list of every disputed root skips whichever ones the map places last.
水族箱
